s1.syndrome_frame: A subareolar breast mass with a history of gynecomastia
salient_findings: persistent swelling of the left breast
new, mildly tender, firm 1-cm subareolar mass
key_facts: persistent swelling of the left breast for four years
new subareolar mass is mildly tender and firm
repeat ultrasonography demonstrates a 1.5-cm long, solid structure with lobular architecture
mammography reveals a lobulated retroareolar mass approximately 1.5 cm in diameter

raw.syndrome_frame: A subareolar breast mass with a history of gynecomastia
salient_findings: persistent swelling of the left breast
new, mildly tender, firm 1-cm subareolar mass
key_facts: persistent swelling of the left breast for four years
new subareolar mass is mildly tender and firm
repeat ultrasonography demonstrates a 1.5-cm long, solid structure with lobular architecture
mammography reveals a lobulated retroareolar mass approximately 1.5 cm in diameter

shortlist.label: Male breast cancer
shortlist.why_kept: New subareolar mass with solid structure and lobular architecture, BIRADS III mammography result

shortlist.label: Gynecomastia
shortlist.why_kept: History of gynecomastia and anabolic-steroid use, persistent breast swelling

shortlist.label: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Solid structure with lobular architecture on ultrasonography, possible benign lesion

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Lobulated retroareolar mass on mammography, possible benign tumor

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Lobulated mass with solid structure, possible rare benign or malignant tumor

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of gynecomastia and anabolic-steroid use, which is a known cause of gynecomastia. Although a new mass has developed, the presence of lobular architecture on ultrasonography and a lobulated mass on mammography without microcalcifications is more consistent with gynecomastia or a benign lesion rather than malignancy.

rejected.label: Male breast cancer
rejected.why: The lack of microcalcifications and the lobular architecture of the mass make cancer less likely.

rejected.label: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia
rejected.why: This condition is rare and typically presents with a mass, but the clinical context and imaging findings do not specifically suggest this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: Fibroadenomas are common in women, but less common in men, and the clinical context and imaging findings do not specifically suggest this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors are rare and typically present with a rapidly growing mass, which is not consistent with the patient's presentation.
